title: Mysterious Altar
body: A slab of black stone sits in a clearing, worn smooth by hands that are no longer attached to anyone. Something in the grooves catches the light and does not let it go.

outcomes.text: The stone drinks and pays you in coin.
Something old decides you are worth arming.
You feel a weight leave your deck.
Wise.

title: Wandering Merchant
body: A hunched figure unrolls a mat of trinkets before you have finished deciding whether to be afraid. "No refunds," they say, before you have asked anything at all.

outcomes.text: You acquire something with history.
Tucked in with the rest of your spells.

options.label: Pay 40 Gold to sharpen a card

outcomes.text: The merchant's whetstone is not for blades.
They do not look up.

title: Ancient Fountain
body: Water runs uphill here. It has done so for a very long time and seems entirely unbothered about it.

outcomes.text: It tastes like cold metal and it helps enormously.

options.label: Wash a card from your deck

outcomes.text: The spell dissolves with the water.
It keeps running uphill.

title: Cursed Idol
body: A small figure of fused metal sits on a pedestal, warm to the touch. Holding it feels like being owed something.

outcomes.text: It comes with you, and it takes its rent.
It shatters into coins. Somehow.
It is still warm behind you.

title: Training Ground
body: Old straw dummies stand in a ring, all of them thoroughly destroyed by someone who has long since left.

outcomes.text: You understand one of your spells much better now.
Painful, but you picked something up.
A short sit does you good.

title: Elemental Rift
body: A tear in the air cycles through colours, pausing on each as though asking a question. It wants to give you something. It will also take something.

outcomes.text: Heat pours into your channels.
Cold pours in, steadying you.
It crackles and leaves something behind.
You pull back a hand you cannot feel.
It cycles on without you.

title: Lost Library
body: Shelves rise into darkness in every direction. Somewhere down there, a book is about to be exactly what you need.

outcomes.text: The words fight back. You win anyway.
A scholar would weep. You are not a scholar.
Something turns a page behind you.

title: Shrine of Chaos
body: The shrine has no fixed shape. Praying here is a coin flip with the coin still spinning.

outcomes.text: Wealth, inexplicably.
Warmth floods back into you.
It answers with teeth.
It leaves a gift, out of curiosity.
It watches you go, disappointed.

title: Abandoned Smithy
body: The forge is cold but the tools are laid out as though the smith is coming back any moment. They are not coming back.

outcomes.text: There is more of value here than scrap.
Everything sells eventually.

options.label: Leave the tools where they are

outcomes.text: Someone should keep the place tidy.

title: Witch's Cauldron
body: Something is bubbling unattended. The bubbles are going in the wrong direction, which is either a very bad sign or a very good one.

options.label: Add a pinch of yourself (-6 HP)

outcomes.text: It produces a bottle it was clearly saving for you.
The spell dissolves. The pot cools over something shiny.
It continues regardless.
